sets.title: IEEE 101
sets.description: How well do you know IEEE? 10 questions, 30 seconds each. Answer fast for bonus points!

questions.q: What does IEEE stand for?
options: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers
Institute of Electronic and Embedded Engineering

questions.q: In which year was IEEE created?
questions.explain: IEEE was formed in 1963 by a merger of two older organizations.

questions.q: IEEE was formed by merging which two organizations?
questions.explain: The American Institute of Electrical Engineers (1884) and the Institute of Radio Engineers (1912).

questions.q: What is IEEE's tagline?
The IEEE logo's diamond shape represents what?
questions.explain: The kite also carries an arrow illustrating the right-hand rule of electromagnetism.

questions.q: Tunisia belongs to which IEEE Region?
questions.explain: Region 8 covers Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

questions.q: What is IEEE Xplore?
options: A digital library of research papers and standards

questions.q: What is IEEEXtreme?
options: A 24-hour global programming competition for students

questions.q: IEEE Day celebrates the first gathering of IEEE's founders. In which month is it celebrated?
What is IEEE's highest award?
Which IEEE affinity group supports women in engineering and technology?
What is the name of IEEE's flagship magazine sent to members?

sets.title: Tech Basics
sets.description: Easy general tech questions — perfect for beginners!

questions.q: What does CPU stand for?
questions.explain: The CPU is the "brain" that executes instructions.

questions.q: Which of these is an input device?
What does "www" stand for in web addresses?
How many bits are in one byte?
Which language is used to build the structure of web pages?
What does RAM do?
options: Temporarily holds data for running programs

questions.q: Which of these is an operating system?
Which digits does the binary system use?
What does AI stand for?
Which password is the strongest?
What is phishing?
options: Fake messages that try to steal your information
A type of computer virus scanner

questions.q: What is a "bug" in programming?
Which of these is a programming language?
What is a URL?
options: The address of a web page

questions.q: Which company develops Android?
What does "cloud storage" mean?
options: Saving files on remote servers through the internet
Saving files on a USB stick

questions.q: Who is often called the first computer programmer?
What does Wi-Fi let you do?
options: Connect to a network without cables

sets.title: Our Student Branch & Chapters
sets.description: How well do you know the IEEE ISIMA Student Branch, its chapters and its events? 10 questions, 30 seconds each.

questions.q: How many members does IEEE ISIMA SB have?
How many officers lead our SB's activities?
How many chapters and affinity groups does our SB have?
Which of these is NOT one of our SB's chapters or affinity groups?
questions.explain: Our 4 are CS, CIS, RAS and WIE.

questions.q: What does CS stand for in our chapters?
What does CIS stand for?
What does RAS stand for?
What does WIE stand for?
Which chapter focuses on neural networks, fuzzy systems and evolutionary computation?
In computational intelligence, evolutionary computation is mainly about…?
Which of these topics does our CS chapter cover?
options: Software engineering, cybersecurity, cloud and IoT

questions.q: AURA, organized by our SB, is a national congress about…?
questions.explain: AURA = Annual Union of Robotics & AI.

questions.q: "Unmasking Cyber Threats" is our event about…?
Which 24-hour global programming competition does our SB host?
What is RamadhanIEEET?
options: A Ramadan evening where members break their fast together
